title: MarkdStage — Markdown, ready for the stage.
description: From Markdown to your next talk. Turn code, diagrams, and ideas into polished slides with the open-source presentation tool for GitHub Copilot Canvas, Windows, and the CLI.
heroDescription: Create slides from Markdown, with code, architecture diagrams, and speaker notes. Present and export to PDF or PowerPoint from the same source.
heroAlt: An architecture slide rendered in MarkdStage's light theme, connecting a browser to an API and a database.
heroCaption: Actual output from the MarkdStage renderer
heroNote: Edit, present, and share. Keep the .md.
examplesDescription: Explore examples with code and diagrams. Switch between them to compare the source with its actual rendered output.
markdownAlt: A dark slide with a heading, three bullet points, and syntax-highlighted JavaScript.
architectureAlt: An architecture diagram connecting a browser, API, and database, with positions, icons, and connectors defined in Architecture DSL.
markdownDescription: Headings, lists, and code. The Markdown you already write becomes the story you want to tell.
architectureDescription: Keep the diagram in the source, too. Define positions, icons, and connections in JSON for layouts that stay where you put them.
editorDescription: Move, connect, and arrange nodes in the Architecture Editor. Save, and your changes go back to Markdown. No separate diagram file to keep in sync.
editorAlt: The MarkdStage Architecture Editor, with an API node selected and its position and style available for editing.
workflowTitle:
One Markdown source.
From draft to delivery.

steps.title: Write in Markdown.
steps.body: Use your favorite editor. Separate slides with ---. Review changes in Git. Keep your attention on what you want to say.

steps.title: Check the layout.
steps.body: Choose a theme, arrange your diagrams, and check the fixed 16:9 output preview. Ask GitHub Copilot for help, or work directly.

steps.title: Present and share.
steps.body: Notes for you. Slides for the room. Present in a synchronized audience window, then share a PDF or hybrid editable PowerPoint.

startDescription: Choose the way that fits your workflow. Wherever you start, Markdown stays the source of truth.
cliDescription: Present, preview, validate, and export without the canvas. Fits workflows with Codex and Claude Code, too.
cliRequirements: Requires Node.js 24 or later and Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome, or Chromium.
cliNext: Create slides.md and run the command. Choose “Start presentation” in the dashboard that opens.
desktopDescription: Open Markdown without Copilot. Keep the current slide, next slide, and speaker notes in view while presenting.
desktopDetail: Portable builds · x64 / ARM64 · Checksums included
canvasDescription: “Turn this Markdown into slides.” Go from a first draft to diagram edits and your presentation in the GitHub Copilot App canvas.
canvasPrompt: Install MarkdStage at user scope from the following GitHub repository folder.
canvasWarning: The Extension runs local code. Review its contents before installing and use a trusted release.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
copyUnavailable: Clipboard is unavailable. Select the text and copy it manually.
